title: Fix Uri System to Only Use Uri Escaping Without Case Changes
description: URIs should only be URI-escaped (percent encoding) and must NOT contain any modifications such as case changing. Fix PathToUriPath, PathFromUriPath, SectionIdValueToUriPath, DefinitionIdValueToUriPath, StatuteIdToUriPath, StatuteUriPathToId, IdToUri, GetArtifactURI, and all related tests.
summary: Fixed the URI system to only use URI-escaping (percent encoding) without any case changes, slugification, or other transformations. Updated PathToUriPath, SectionIdValueToUriPath, DefinitionIdValueToUriPath, StatuteUriPathToId, IdToUri, GetArtifactURI, UriToId, and all URI-related tests. All 13 URI tests pass.
